title: Pocketwire Rewards Giving Programme: Donating the Whole Points Balance to a Partner Charity
content:
A Pocketwire Rewards member can donate the whole points balance to one of the tier's partner charities, while the membership is active and none of the balance is pending.

## Conditions of a whole-balance donation

1. Points can be redeemed only while the membership status is active, and only redeemable points can be redeemed; a charity redemption goes only to one of the tier's partner charities, and Pocketwire's own matching donation of the tier's matching percentage is never credited to the member.
2. A whole-balance charity donation is available only when none of the points balance is still pending, so that the whole balance is redeemable. The donation is booked as one entry carrying the partner charity the member names.
3. A whole-balance charity donation is recorded only after the ledger carries the courtesy credit owed for every gift card or charity redemption fulfilled later than its fulfilment period. While a courtesy credit owed for such a redemption is not on the ledger, a whole-balance charity donation is not recorded.
4. Before a whole-balance charity donation is valued, the ledger must carry the quarterly milestone bonus for every ended quarter whose qualifying spend reached the milestone. While the ledger lacks the quarterly milestone bonus of such an ended quarter, a whole-balance charity donation is not valued.

## Availability at a glance (hypothetical memberships)

| Membership status | Points still pending | Charity named | Whole-balance donation available |
|---|---|---|---|
| active | none | one of the tier's partner charities | Yes |
| active | none | a charity that is not a partner charity of the tier | No |
| active | some | a partner charity | No |
| suspended | any | any | No |

## Donation tool: donate_points_to_charity_56fec22b

Situation of use and capability. The tool donates the member's own Pocketwire Rewards points to a Pocketwire partner charity. It books one charity redemption entry on the member's points ledger, dated today, for the points and partner charity given and with the donation value given, and subtracts the points from the points balance. The donation appears in the app's points activity with its redemption reference and is sent to the charity within the tier's fulfilment period.

How it is invoked. `donate_points_to_charity_56fec22b` is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, confirming the donation in person.

Parameters.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the rewards membership reference number of the member donating, as read out by the agent from the rewards membership lookup | reference number |
| `points` | the points donated, as told by the agent | a whole integer number of points, zero or positive |
| `payee_name` | the partner charity exactly as the member named it in the conversation | verbatim, character for character with its original wording and punctuation |
| `cash_value` | the donation value, as told by the agent | USD, 2 decimal places |

Return. A text rendering of a dictionary with `status` (the text "donated" when the donation was booked), `redemption_reference` (the redemption reference shown in the app), `rewards_entry_id` (reference number of the new points entry), `points` (integer points donated), `payee_name` (partner charity), `cash_value` (donation value in USD, 2 decimal places), `entry_date` (donation date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `points_balance` (the integer points balance left once the donation is booked).
